label: Heavy going
summary: Both of the world's big wars hardened today. Trump said Tehran is not ready for the right deal and called the Strait of Hormuz American territory; Iran's foreign ministry called the new sanctions a declaration of war, while President Pezeshkian argued it is time to end the conflict 'from a position of power'. In Ukraine, a Russian double-tap strike on a Kryvyi Rih shopping centre killed at least 16 and injured 130, and ballistic missiles hit Kyiv overnight. US-Canada trade talks collapsed at the deadline, triggering 50 percent tariffs on $20bn of goods and a dollar-for-dollar retaliation pledge from Mark Carney. The UN said DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading exponentially past 2,500 deaths. Against that: a judge struck down the 75-country visa ban, Africa's largest solar-plus-storage plant came online, and markets steadied. No editorial adjustment.
